use dep::fuzk;
use mimc::mimc_bn254;
use schnorr::verify_signature;
use std::embedded_curve_ops::EmbeddedCurvePoint;

#[export]
fn main(
    merkle_root_singularity: pub Field,
    merkle_index_singularity: [u1; 32],
    merkle_path_singularity: [Field; 32],

    merkle_root_dark_swap: pub Field,
    merkle_index_dark_swap: [u1; 32],
    merkle_path_dark_swap: [Field; 32],

    address: pub Field,
    asset: Field,
    amount: Field,

    singularity_note: Field,
    singularity_rho: Field,
    singularity_nullifier: pub Field,

    dark_swap_existing_note: Field,
    dark_swap_existing_amount: Field,
    dark_swap_existing_rho: Field,
    dark_swap_existing_nullifier: pub Field,

    dark_swap_note: pub Field,
    dark_swap_rho: Field,
    dark_swap_note_footer: pub Field,

    pub_key: [Field; 2],
    signature: [u8; 64]
) {
    let fee_ratio_zero:Field = 0;

    fuzk::assert_note_with_membership(
        merkle_root_singularity,
        merkle_index_singularity,
        merkle_path_singularity,
        address,
        singularity_note,
        asset,
        amount,
        singularity_rho,
        fee_ratio_zero,
        pub_key,
        Option::some(0),
        false,
        false
    );
    
    fuzk::assert_nullifier(
        singularity_nullifier,
        singularity_rho,
        pub_key,
    );

    if dark_swap_existing_amount != 0 {
        fuzk::assert_note_with_membership(
            merkle_root_dark_swap,
            merkle_index_dark_swap,
            merkle_path_dark_swap,
            address,
            dark_swap_existing_note,
            asset,
            dark_swap_existing_amount,
            dark_swap_existing_rho,
            fee_ratio_zero,
            pub_key,
            Option::some(1),
            true,
            false
        );
        fuzk::assert_nullifier(
            dark_swap_existing_nullifier,
            dark_swap_existing_rho,
            pub_key,
        );
    }

    fuzk::assert_note(
        dark_swap_note,
        address,
        asset,
        amount + dark_swap_existing_amount,
        dark_swap_rho,
        fee_ratio_zero,
        pub_key,
        Option::some(2),
        true,
        false
    );
    fuzk::assert_note_footer(dark_swap_note_footer, dark_swap_rho, pub_key);

    let signature_domain = 10010;

    let m = mimc_bn254([
        signature_domain, 
        singularity_nullifier,
        dark_swap_existing_nullifier,
        address,
        dark_swap_note
    ]);
    let m_bytes = fuzk::to_bytes(m);

    let pub_key_point: EmbeddedCurvePoint = EmbeddedCurvePoint { x: pub_key[0], y: pub_key[1], is_infinite: false };
    let v = verify_signature(pub_key_point, signature, m_bytes);
    assert(v);
}
